trips.name: Step by step, peak by peak ⛰️

steps.title: Staring with an anxious mood as always 😅
Dibrugarh airport
steps.description:
I was anxious as always. I get anxious every time I on a trip. 

So my flask broke and water was leaking, I had to throw out all the water but, the flight was early and my BnB owner at Kathmandu arranged a driver to pick me up from Bagdogra and drop me off at Bhadrapur at a very reasonable price so that was a good news.

So yeah my first international trip let's goooo... 🙂‍↔️

steps.title: Well my pickup arrived before me despite my flight being early.
steps.description: So I landed at about 1:30, too early than my planed schedule. Surprisingly his mother was from a nearby place from my home and we had a very nice chat.

steps.title: En route to Bhadrapur
steps.description:
So Prakash (my cab driver) helped we with border security, currency exchange and getting a new SIM.

While swapping my SIM the slot was stuck and he was kind enough to fix that in a nearby store free of cost and then I went for lunch with him though he didn't have lunch and only had a red bull.

On our ways to catch my next flight we took a detour through the countryside, the view as amazing even though I didn't click much pictures. I was a bit worried about what I'll do since my flight is at 6:40 PM.

steps.title: Bhadrapur: Airports in nepal are strange
steps.description:
So my fight was at 6:40 PM and I arrived at the airport at 2:41 PM. 

Well the people here are so kind, the security checks didn't felt like a security check and more like yeah we trust you 😅. 

So I walked up to the counter for my seat and surprisingly the guy told me that do I want to switch to an early flight whose boarding is about to start (apparently that happens here) so I definitely opted for it. While waiting for my flight had a really nice chat with a local kid, we weren't on the same flights because apparently the airline with whom I booked my flight had an accident here and doesn't have a nice reputation around here 😅.

I took a window seat on the left side hoping for a view of the Himalayan ranges but, wasn't able to view because of the clouds but, oh my the clouds were so breathtaking I felt so good after so long. 

PS: I'm so delusional, while flying through the clouds. I had a belief that someday I will fly a plane by myself (the small single person ones) through clouds like these.

steps.title: Kathmandu Airport
steps.description: Too tired 😫

steps.title: Groceries

steps.title: Breakfast
steps.description:
I woke up a bit late and wanted to leave as fast as possible but, faith had other plans for me I got stuck with uncle and had a very long conversation. Well in the back of my mind I was like when can I leave , how can I end this conversation without sounding rude. But now when I look back at the moment It wasn't bad it, I had a good conversation.

P.S: Uncle had to be admitted to the hospital in the evening for health issues.

steps.title: Pashupati
steps.description:
Pashupati was full of emotions, the ones that I thought I was incapable of feeling.

So it started of good, I was amazing by the architectural wonders untill I was on the bridge and looked towards the cremation ground. Initially I was like, "well people die, that's how life is" untill I walked into the grounds filled with smoke and smell of burning flesh that's when the weight of life had a grip on me . The grip intensified on my way out of the cremation ground when I saw 3 babies being brought for cremation followed by a greaving mother.

I was deeply stuck by that and that stayed with me for the rest of the day. 

Later I sat by river bagmati and contemplated on this thought and many other.

steps.title: Everything that a beginning has an end
Dibrugarh Airport
steps.description:
As always I was anxious but the driver was a very jolly person and we had a very nice conversation and by the time I reached airport my mode was lifted and thus I felt less anxious while waiting for my flight. 

Well my seat was upgraded to a more leg space seat for free so that's a plus point I was a bit anxious during the flight.

steps.description: Well the stay is very beautiful, I'm not sure if it a bit overpriced. But it's very private and cozy. The tv broke on the second day, I reported to the owner and he suggested that he can replace it if needed but, I didn't need the tv anyway.

steps.description:
Went to a nearby pub in the evening a bit too early, I was the only person on the pub. Prolly wasn't a very nice decission that I made. 

After a few drinks I got sad 😅

steps.title: Deolo hill
steps.description:
Deolo hill was very crowded. I chose to do paragliding it costed me 3500 and I thought what a waste of money in the beginning but once I was on the sky I realised every penny of it was worth it. Oh and also I was very anxious and scared in the beginning, the pilot was an amazing guy and suggested me to relax and enjoy the view. 

I think I want learn to paraglide and fly on my own someday.

After paragliding I went to the park the view from the park was beautiful. Also I asked the paragliding operator to suggest me a less crowded place to go to next and he suggested me lava. This was one of the best advice I have received in my life.

steps.title: Lava
steps.description: Lava was crowded too, but the road to lave from deolo hill was so amazing I felt very blissful and I was immersed in the moment, my mind so quite during the ride.

steps.title: Kagyu thekchenling Monastery
steps.description: Since lava was crowded and from the viewpoint I saw a Monestry so wanted to visit it. Got a keychain from the gift shop there.

steps.title: The melting pot bistro
steps.description:
The plan was to eat at a place called TSUMA but, it was closed so ended up in the melting pot bistro.

The food was good the hostest was so beautiful I had that love at first sight moment, still can't sake of that feeling 😔

steps.title: Rishyap
steps.description:
So I didn't have any plan for today and this place came to my mind since google review said that kanchanjunga can be viewed from here.

Well I was a little mad at myself because because It was near lava and I could have visited it yesterday felt like I wasted a day on the same route , but that faded after some time. I made a ciggerate stop at a small shop by the road on my way back ended up having momos on their suggestions, well it was good.

Also I thought of going to TSUMA today since it was closed yesterday but it's was closed today as well. 

Ended up having momos in a small food stall nearby, I wanted to have Faley (a local food) but it wasn't available.

Also I arrived at my stay around 3 pm and thought to myself that I have wasted my time arriving early and it would be a waste of money since I booked the scooty for 2 days. Guess what it started raining around 4 pm. 

The universe seems to work my way.

Also I took a few small detours, best decission.

steps.title: Sakya Monastery
steps.description:
So this was one of the detours I was taking about in my previous step.

This Monestry has a residential school I think for orphans or less fortunate and I had to go through the school to the Monestry a few young monks were playing basketball and a little one was watching from the top floor I offered him a candy I got from the ciggerate stop earlier and waved him bye.

So the monastery was completed empty and I felt very overwhelmed, had one of those moments that you can't explain because there aren't any words for it.

While returning from the monastery two monks about 5-6 years old were dancing and rushing to a nearby shop the sight was so beautiful couldn't take a picture though.

Since I have returned the scooty yesterday I decided to stay at my room today. Will explore the local market in the evening.

Meanwhile thinking of reading a few pages from, "My journey to Lasa"

steps.title: Wandering aimlessly without any destination.
steps.description:
I had one of the best days of my life. The plan was to go to Lolegaon — I ended up wandering aimlessly instead.

The road was very scenic. I met a 10th standard schoolgirl who was having stomach pain and had stopped me thinking I was a local. They usually walk 4–5 km to school. I gave her a lift home. She said I look Nepali — the second time someone here in Kalimpong had said that to me.

Being able to help someone immediately lifted my mood, so the rest of the journey was blissful. The little girl also suggested I visit a peak where people camp, though I didn't go there.

The road was surrounded by bamboo groves and trees, and occasionally there were flowers scattered across it — which made me feel like a king being welcomed on a flower-bedded road. What an amazing feeling. After dropping her off, I continued aimlessly to a place I didn't know, amazed by the scenic beauty and the small homes perched on the hillside. People here plant flowers even along the roadside.

After reaching Deurali, I decided to turn back. I stopped at a bus stand for a cigarette break and had an amazing conversation with the owner. He mostly talked about his wish to travel — how he would visit Nagaland someday. He was the third person to think I was Nepali.

On the way back, it started to rain a little. I had that God is in the rain moment from V for Vendetta. Felt extremely blissful — and this thought came to me: may all beings find happiness.

Now, writing this, I keep thinking — if only I had been articulate enough to express what I felt during that journey, so you could feel it too.
